headline: Aurobindo Pharma Limited: Amalgamation/Merger
sum: Amalgamation/Merger - Aurobindo Pharma Limited has informed the Exchange about proposal of merger of the two wholly owned stepdown subsidiaries with a wholly owned subsidiary of the Company.
